name: Aiba Naoki
source:
4th year university student.
Star Sign: Aries
Hobby: Watching Movies
Likes: Spicy Food
Dislikes: Bell Peppers, Carrots, Green Peas, His older sister

A fellow university student along with the protagonist, he's also job searching.
Because he doesn't talk much and has a serious face people are scared of him, but he's really just a straightforward guy who takes things too logically sometimes.
